meta.title: How To Train Your Dragon
meta.timeline_point: conclusion of Race to the Edge (before How To Train Your Dragon 2)
meta.genre_and_tone: warm Viking adventure — flying, friendship and daring rescues, with danger that always lands gently
meta.narrative_voice: close third person, wry and affectionate, rich in dragon detail

canon.rule: Dragons are intelligent, feeling creatures who choose their riders; they are partners, never property.
A dragon is trained by earning trust — an open hand, a turned-away gaze, patience — and a bond once made lasts for life.
Every dragon belongs to a class — Stoker, Boulder, Tracker, Sharp, Tidal, Strike, Mystery or Fear — which predicts how it flies and fights.
A dragon carries only so many shots before it must rest and reload, and Hiccup counts Toothless at about six plasma blasts.
A Night Fury is Strike Class: the fastest and quietest flier known, firing explosive blue-white plasma blasts with uncanny accuracy.
In darkness or fog a Night Fury navigates by echolocation, crying out and reading the sound that returns.
Toothless lost his left tail fin years ago, and the replacement Hiccup built is worked from the saddle, so he cannot fly properly without his rider.
Nearly every dragon is terrified of eels, and the sight of one will panic even a calm dragon.
Dragon Nip is a herb that soothes and delights dragons; Dragon Root does the opposite and turns a gentle dragon wild.
Gronckle Iron is made by feeding a Gronckle iron ore and limestone, and what it spits out is lighter and far stronger than ordinary iron.
Dragon fire has personality: a Monstrous Nightmare sets its whole body alight, a Zippleback sprays gas from one head and sparks it with the other, and a Gronckle spits molten lava.
Berk and its dragons live in peace — dragons nest on the rooftops and share the work — and the Riders defend the archipelago instead of fighting dragons.
Dragon Hunters trap and sell dragons for gold, and Dragon Flyers ride captured dragons that obey out of fear rather than trust.
Dragons must obey the call of an Alpha, and the mightiest Alpha the Riders have seen is a Bewilderbeast.
Some dragon eggs, Gronckle eggs especially, explode when they hatch, which makes a stolen egg worth a war.
Rider gear is homemade — saddles, flight suits, prosthetics and blades all come off Gobber's forge — and anything broken gets mended, not replaced.
Vanaheim is a hidden sanctuary dragons find their own way to, and the Riders have sworn to keep its location secret.

characters.name: Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III
characters.role: leader of the Dragon Riders, Stoick's son, inventor and mapmaker
characters.status: alive and well, moved back to Berk from Dragon's Edge; not chief yet
characters.physical: lean, about twenty, auburn hair, freckles, scarred chin, a prosthetic left leg of his own design
characters.voice: thinks out loud in quick self-deprecating tangents, jokes when nervous, goes quiet and very certain when asking someone to trust him
characters.motivation: peace between people and dragons
possessions: Inferno, a retractable sword fed by Monstrous Nightmare gel and Zippleback gas
knows: how to read almost any dragon's mood
that both Dragon Eyes were destroyed on his own order
does_not_know: that his mother Valka is alive
that any other Night Fury exists
that there is a Hidden World beneath the sea
anything of a warlord named Drago Bludvist

characters.name: Toothless
characters.role: Night Fury, Hiccup's bonded dragon and closest friend
characters.status: alive and thriving; believed by all, himself included, to be the last of his kind
characters.physical: sleek black dragon the size of a small horse, retractable teeth, huge green eyes; his left tail fin is a red leather-and-metal prosthetic
characters.voice: does not speak — warbles, croons, gummy grins, hard clicking growl when unimpressed; halfway between a cat and a very loyal dog
characters.motivation: Hiccup first and last, then flying fast and sleeping warm
possessions: his prosthetic tail fin and saddle rig
knows: every handhold of Hiccup's saddle and every tone of his voice
does_not_know: that he is not the last Night Fury
that a Light Fury exists

characters.name: Astrid Hofferson
characters.role: Dragon Rider, Hiccup's second-in-command and his girlfriend
characters.status: alive and well on Berk; openly together with Hiccup
characters.physical: athletic, long blonde braid, spiked shoulder guards, carries an axe
characters.voice: blunt, dry and a step ahead — names the plan's flaw in one line, punches Hiccup's shoulder before she kisses him, never softens bad news
characters.motivation: keeping the team alive and Hiccup honest about his risks
possessions: a battle axe (her old one was smashed over the King of Dragons)
knows: that Hiccup will be chief and is not ready to hear it
does_not_know: that Valka is alive

characters.name: Stormfly
characters.role: Deadly Nadder, Astrid's bonded dragon
characters.status: alive and well, nesting on Berk
characters.physical: tall blue-and-yellow Nadder, horned beak, spiked tail she fires like darts
characters.voice: does not speak — chirps, preens and struts; a proud affectionate hen with a magpie's love of shiny things
characters.motivation: Astrid's approval, chicken, and anything that glitters
possessions: her saddle and a small hoard of trinkets
knows: the 'Stormfly, spine shot!' command
does_not_know: why humans mind when she takes their jewellery

characters.name: Fishlegs Ingerman
characters.role: Dragon Rider, the team's dragon scholar
characters.status: alive and well, back on Berk
characters.physical: broad and soft-featured in a fur-trimmed tunic, always carrying notes
characters.voice: excited cataloguing — reels off class, wingspan, firepower and shot limit in one breath, squeaks when frightened, calls Meatlug 'my precious girl'
characters.motivation: recording every dragon alive and keeping Meatlug safe
possessions: his dragon notes and stat cards
knows: the class and habits of nearly every dragon the Riders have met
does_not_know: that there are species no book of his has ever named

characters.name: Meatlug
characters.role: Gronckle, Fishlegs's bonded dragon
characters.status: alive and well, on Berk
characters.physical: round brown boulder of a dragon, stubby bumblebee wings, club tail
characters.voice: does not speak — snuffles, drools and hums; a slow, doting, endlessly affectionate lump
characters.motivation: rocks to eat and staying close to Fishlegs
knows: which stones make the best Gronckle Iron
does_not_know: that she is far too large to be a lap dog

characters.name: Snotlout Jorgenson
characters.role: Dragon Rider, Hiccup's cousin
characters.status: alive and well, back on Berk
characters.physical: short and thick-set in a horned helmet, permanently posing
characters.voice: boasts in the third person — 'Snotlout! Snotlout! Oi, oi, oi!' — claims every success, blames the twins for the rest, then quietly does the brave thing
characters.motivation: glory; underneath, not letting the team down
knows: that Hookfang lights himself on fire with him still aboard, and that this is fine
does_not_know: how obvious it is that he would die for any of them

characters.name: Hookfang
characters.role: Monstrous Nightmare, Snotlout's bonded dragon
characters.status: alive and well, on Berk
characters.physical: huge red-and-orange dragon with curling horns who sets his whole body ablaze at will
characters.voice: does not speak — roars, snorts smoke, drops Snotlout in puddles on purpose; the two bicker like brothers
characters.motivation: doing as he pleases, then saving Snotlout at the last second
knows: exactly how far he can push Snotlout
does_not_know: that Snotlout brags about him constantly

characters.name: Ruffnut Thorston
characters.role: Dragon Rider, one half of the twins, shares Barf and Belch
characters.status: alive and well, back on Berk
characters.physical: lanky, long blonde braids and a horned helmet, usually mid-shove
characters.voice: gleeful and contrary — argues with Tuffnut about nothing at full volume, then agrees with him instantly if anyone else objects
characters.motivation: chaos, and being the one who caused it
possessions: her half of the Zippleback saddle
knows: that Barf's gas plus Belch's spark equals an explosion
does_not_know: that the plan she is about to suggest is a terrible one

characters.name: Tuffnut Thorston
characters.role: Dragon Rider, the other half of the twins
characters.status: alive and well, back on Berk
characters.physical: lanky, dreadlocked and helmeted, identical in build to his sister
characters.voice: long solemn tangents about his hair, his chicken and the philosophy of the moment, delivered with total confidence and no relevance; lands on wisdom by accident
characters.motivation: glory, drama, and the wellbeing of Chicken
possessions: his half of the Zippleback saddle
knows: that Chicken is the smartest member of the team
does_not_know: what anyone was just talking about

characters.name: Barf and Belch
characters.role: Hideous Zippleback, the twins' shared dragon
characters.status: alive and well, on Berk
characters.physical: two-headed green dragon on one body; Barf sprays the gas, Belch strikes the spark
characters.voice: does not speak — hisses and clicks; the heads squabble exactly as much as their riders and cooperate perfectly when it counts
characters.motivation: explosions, and carrying both twins at once
knows: that neither head can make a boom without the other
does_not_know: which twin is which, on a bad day

last_seen.state: one head asleep, one chewing a boot

characters.name: Stoick the Vast
characters.role: Chief of Berk, Hiccup's father
characters.status: alive and still chief, quietly ready to hand the village over
characters.physical: mountain of a man, red beard and braids, horned helmet, bear cloak
characters.voice: booming and blunt, warming into gruff tenderness with Hiccup, and calls him 'son' when it matters most
characters.motivation: Berk's safety and Hiccup's future
possessions: his chief's helmet, made from Valka's old breastplate
knows: that Hiccup is ready to be chief before Hiccup does
that years ago a warlord named Drago Bludvist demanded the chiefs' loyalty and destroyed everyone who laughed
does_not_know: that Valka is alive

characters.name: Gobber the Belch
characters.role: Berk's blacksmith, Stoick's oldest friend, Hiccup's mentor
characters.status: alive and well, working the forge on Berk
characters.physical: big and blond-moustached, missing a hand and a leg, both replaced with screw-on tools
characters.voice: cheerful gallows humour and terrible timing — tells alarming stories as light conversation and gives genuinely good advice sideways
characters.motivation: the forge, his friends, and dragon dentistry
knows: how every piece of rider gear on Berk was made, because he made it
does_not_know: when to stop talking

characters.name: Heather
characters.role: dragon rider, Dagur's long-lost sister, once a spy inside the Dragon Hunters
characters.status: alive and well; has chosen to live on Berserker Island with Dagur, her only family
characters.physical: dark-haired, black-and-green scaled armour, double-bladed axe
characters.voice: measured and watchful, warmest with Astrid; speaks like someone long used to keeping a secret and glad to have set it down
characters.motivation: family, and making up for the years spent under cover
knows: how the Dragon Hunters worked from the inside
that Dagur's change of heart is real
does_not_know: what to do with a peaceful life now that she has one

characters.name: Windshear
characters.role: Razorwhip, Heather's bonded dragon
characters.status: alive and well, on Berserker Island
characters.physical: silver dragon in razor-edged metallic scales with a bladed tail that cuts rope and rigging
characters.voice: does not speak — a low metallic rasp; wary of strangers, fiercely protective of Heather alone
characters.motivation: Heather's safety
knows: Heather's whistle from a mile off
does_not_know: how to be gentle with furniture

characters.name: Dagur the Deranged
characters.role: Chief of the Berserker Tribe, ally of the Riders, Heather's brother
characters.status: alive, redeemed and newly married to Mala; rules alongside her
characters.physical: red-haired and tattooed, scarred face, Berserker's grin
characters.voice: still loud and unhinged in delivery, but the menace has turned into ferocious affection — says 'brother' constantly and means it
characters.motivation: holding the family and alliance he nearly threw away
knows: how Dragon Hunters think, having once been their partner
does_not_know: how to be quiet about anything

characters.name: Sleuther
characters.role: Triple Stryke, Dagur's bonded dragon
characters.status: alive and well, on Berserker Island
characters.physical: armoured brown-and-orange dragon with three stinger-tipped tails
characters.voice: does not speak — a deep rumble; calm and steady, the exact opposite of his rider
characters.motivation: Dagur, and a warm place to sun himself
knows: that Dagur's shouting is not anger
does_not_know: what all the fuss is about

characters.name: Mala
characters.role: Queen of the Defenders of the Wing, now Dagur's wife
characters.status: alive and reigning; her tribe and the Berserkers united by the marriage
characters.physical: tall warrior queen in gold-trimmed green armour, long braid, spear
characters.voice: formal, ceremonial and absolutely direct — speaks in vows and declarations, and takes a joke half a beat too late
characters.motivation: the Great Protector, her people, and now her husband
possessions: the crown of the Defenders of the Wing
knows: that her island's Eruptodon, the Great Protector, keeps the volcano from destroying them
does_not_know: how to be informal

last_seen.state: splitting her time between two islands

characters.name: Viggo Grimborn
characters.role: former leader of the Dragon Hunters, Hiccup's cleverest enemy and, at the last, his reluctant ally
characters.status: dead — betrayed by Johann, he turned on his old partners and gave his life so Hiccup and Toothless could escape
characters.physical: was lean and dark-bearded in black furs, and never hurried
characters.voice: spoke softly and precisely, like a man moving a game piece, and enjoyed being understood more than he enjoyed winning
characters.motivation: was the game itself, and at the end denying Johann his victory
possessions: his chess set and war maps, left behind
knows: nothing further — his story is finished
does_not_know: nothing further — his story is finished

last_seen.location: the caves near the King of Dragons
last_seen.state: gone; remembered as an enemy who ended as something else

characters.name: Ryker Grimborn
characters.role: Viggo's older brother, brawler and one-time leader of the Dragon Hunters
characters.status: dead — his ship was dragged under the sea by a Submaripper in the battle over the Shellfire
characters.physical: was huge, bearded and heavily armoured, and fought with a broadsword
characters.voice: spoke in blunt threats and had no patience for his brother's schemes
characters.motivation: was gold and command, and escaping Viggo's shadow
possessions: his broadsword, lost with the ship
knows: nothing further — his story is finished
does_not_know: nothing further — his story is finished

characters.name: Krogan
characters.role: commander of the Dragon Flyers, who rode dragons broken by force
characters.status: alive but vanished — driven off by Toothless at the King of Dragons' nest, he leapt from the cliff and escaped without a trace
characters.physical: tall and dark-armoured, shaved head, heavy fur mantle
characters.voice: cold, clipped and contemptuous; never raises his voice and never explains himself twice
characters.motivation: control — of dragons, of the Flyers, of whoever pays him next
possessions: the cruel pinch-hold he uses to force a dragon to obey
knows: how to break a dragon's will by force
the Flyers' hidden routes through the archipelago
does_not_know: that the Riders destroyed both Dragon Eyes
that his own Singetail is free and will never carry him again

characters.name: Johann
characters.role: the trader who visited Berk for years, secretly the mastermind behind the Dragon Hunters
characters.status: dead — frozen by the Bewilderbeast, the true King of Dragons, as he moved against Hiccup
characters.physical: was round and cheerful and elaborately dressed, with a ship full of curiosities
characters.voice: spoke in flowery endless anecdotes — 'but that is a tale for another time' — which turned out to be a very long disguise
characters.motivation: was the King of Dragons, and power over every dragon alive
possessions: his trading ship and hoard of maps, abandoned
knows: nothing further — his story is finished
does_not_know: nothing further — his story is finished

last_seen.location: the nest of the King of Dragons
last_seen.state: gone; the Riders still struggle to believe it

relationships.state: inseparable — one mind in two bodies
relationships.history: Hiccup shot Toothless down and could not finish him; the tail fin he built made them need each other to fly.

relationships.state: openly a couple, easy and affectionate; not engaged and not discussing it
relationships.history: Years of rivalry became partnership on the Edge, and by the end neither pretends otherwise.

relationships.state: warm and proud, with an unspoken question about when Hiccup takes the chiefdom
relationships.history: Father and son spent years failing to understand each other and finally do.

relationships.state: allies and, in Dagur's insistent telling, brothers
relationships.history: Dagur hunted Hiccup for years before turning on the Hunters and earning his way back.

relationships.state: reunited siblings; Heather has chosen to live on Berserker Island with him
relationships.history: She learned he was her brother while spying on the Hunters, and refused to believe in him until he proved it.

relationships.state: newly married, joining the Berserkers and the Defenders of the Wing
relationships.history: A courtship of grand gestures and mutual bafflement, ending in a wedding the whole archipelago attended.

relationships.state: six riders and their bonded dragons, bickering constantly and ready to die for each other
relationships.history: Three years together on Dragon's Edge welded them into one crew.

locations.name: Berk
locations.description: A rocky island village of steep roofs and longhouses, twelve days north of hopeless, where dragons nest on the rooftops and help with the work
locations.state: home again — the Riders have moved back, the village is at peace, Stoick still chief

locations.name: Dragon's Edge
locations.description: The Riders' outpost on a far island: clubhouse, stables, launch platforms and Hiccup's workshop, built by the six of them
locations.state: empty — they said goodbye and returned to Berk; the buildings still stand, scarred by volcano and hunters

locations.name: Berserker Island
locations.description: The Berserker Tribe's stronghold of dark timber halls and high walls
locations.state: peaceful and allied to Berk, ruled by Dagur and Mala together; Heather lives there

locations.name: Caldera Cay
locations.description: Island of the Defenders of the Wing, built around a live volcano that an Eruptodon called the Great Protector keeps from erupting
locations.state: at peace, united with the Berserkers by Mala's marriage

locations.name: Vanaheim
locations.description: A hidden island sanctuary dragons find their own way to, where the King of Dragons — a Bewilderbeast — nests
locations.state: safe and secret; both Dragon Eyes were destroyed so no map could lead a hunter there
